QA: Hole 4 left, between red areas P27 (south) and P26 (north): the same dense grey-brown sage/chaparral scrub hillside from the cart-path edge (path kept outside) up to the OB perimeter, ~1,800 m2 not yet red only because course_surfaces classes it rough. LiDAR 414 -> 434 m, mean slope 48 % (pipeline canyon rule >= 35 %). 25-35 m left of the green; no tee/pin/aim/play surface inside (hole-5 Gold tee 17 m, nearest pin 30 m). Verified QA round (holes 4-6).

QA: Hole 10 left of the approach (54 m off the fairway, 77 m from the green): concrete flood-control debris basin on golf parcel 4493-035-004, inside the perimeter. Photo: concrete floor, riser outlet, concrete inlet channel from the NW. LiDAR: floor 359.6-360.0 m impounded 6-7 m below a berm crest at ~366.5 m on the S and E sides (the outline follows the crest there). Classed rough today. An open drainage structure counts as a penalty area even when dry (rule 4.1), so it is red. 1,925 m2, no tee, pin, aim point or play surface within 50 m. Low priority. Verified QA round (holes 10-12).

QA: Hole 11 (SI 1) left: the canyon the hole doglegs around (spec known target; club 2008: OB left off the tee, canyon carry left), filled as one red penalty area. Today only patches are red (#4, part of #5, #8, #9, #17) because most of the slope is classed rough. West edge on the top of the slope / mown line: E-W LiDAR profiles fall 60-80 m from ~350 m to 265-290 m at the perimeter; across the edge the slope is 9-22 % outside and 36-59 % inside; 4.7 m from the fairway at the closest, never over fairway, semirough (3.2 m), tee (8.8 m) or paths (19.8 m). East edge on the OB perimeter (0 m2 outside it, no inner OB), north edge at the tee complex (N 3774881), south edge joins the green-side canyon #5. The verifier also filled two general-area pockets (812 + 61 m2, 363403-363461 E, 3774624-3774650 N) that would otherwise stay enclosed between this polygon and #5 short-left of the green: rough-classed brush on the canyon slope 5-15 m below the green. All on golf parcels 4493-035-003/-004. 4.68 ha. Hole-11 tees 13-34 m clear, aim point 28 m, pins >= 37 m. Verified QA round (holes 10-12).
